The reason is that we will first find out the valid size of sequence parallelism, and then remove numbers that are not the multiple of tp size. These two steps are very likely dropping the user's setup number. Thus, we need to round it up to number above what has been setup.
Cannot simply add a tp size to the last graph size, this will run into a comflict when computing graph. So we make the max graph capture size consistent with the valid max size as vllm does.
